scope: Read-only audit of captured execution and current relevant code; no external financial fact checking or production modifications.
question: 从资料库中，检索今天研报你观察A股市场如何，那些是潜在的交易对象
assessment: Partial historical research delivered; not a completed current-day research answer or a fully verified report.
observed_guards: Busy verification session assignment rejected at approximately 349.1 seconds.
Retry with changed subject rejected; corrected subject revision subsequently dispatched.
Final publication rejected corpus-wide absence statements and missing checked excerpt.
Final publication rejected manifest quotes absent verbatim from candidate content.
Final text limits freshness claims to this bounded search and discloses missing current-day evidence.

findings.evidence: Research explicitly says table period labels for turnover 19697.8, margin balance 26190.4 and net inflow -28.8 were not retrieved. Captured fetch for turnover contains only the label and number, structure_status=unknown and relation_status=unknown. job.6 macro_numbers nevertheless marks date/conditions match and PASS, borrowing a trading-week sentence from a different communications report. Final calls the combined paragraph checked while elsewhere admitting period assignment is an inference.
findings.acceptance_target: Require source-local period/table-header linkage or retain unknown status; matching a numeric token alone cannot establish time scope.

findings.evidence: job.5 ends incomplete with logical_call_deadline; job.6 replaces its date_coverage and macro_numbers checks and both pass. Task t5 records verification_status=passed and verification_execution_status=complete, but execution_status=incomplete. Delivery rejects resolved because workflows/agent_team/delivery.py checks every historical execution_job_id for complete, regardless of replacement. Coordinator changes t5 to blocked to deliver.
findings.qualification: Separate uncovered sector claims and freshness limitations still justify overall partial; fixing recovery accounting alone would not make the whole report fully verified.
findings.acceptance_target: Keep failed attempt history while settling obligations through explicit successful replacement relationships.

findings.evidence: Sector assignment asks for 3-5 themes, catalysts, data, risks, full source locators, unresolved gaps and an 800-character body. Member invokes bash 10 times to write/count/trim/read drafts, with outputs 971,910,897,827,813,801,883,795 CJK characters; last edit is denied by handoff-only window. First to last bash attempt spans 245.8 to 326.6 seconds. Sector member uses 22 model attempts and 1359942 known input tokens.
findings.acceptance_target: Use an approximate prose budget with structured citations outside it and a bounded formatting pass; prohibit research-budget exhaustion through repeated counting.

findings.evidence: Coordinator dispatch explicitly tells the researcher to say 资料库不含今日研报 when near-current reports are absent, based on inventory and 2-3 date samples. Later verification and publication correctly reject this absolute absence claim because coverage is partial and dates unknown. First final draft repeats the already-rejected absence statement in its introduction even after the checked paragraph was corrected.
findings.acceptance_target: Use bounded-search phrasing consistently in assignment templates and synthesis; prevent rejected claims from reappearing outside the checked excerpt.

findings.evidence: 37 corpus_search calls have recorded median 23478 ms; 23 corpus_fetch calls median 97 ms. Search requests overlap across agents. Current corpus_search implementation uses asyncio.to_thread. Artifacts do not expose search-stage latency breakdown.
findings.qualification: Recorded overlapping tool durations cannot be summed as wall time, nor do they prove the old synchronous event-loop bug returned. Database/embedding/rerank/queue attribution requires instrumentation.
findings.acceptance_target: Capture per-stage and queue timings; benchmark identical corpus queries at controlled concurrency.

findings.evidence: Final candidate_verification remains not_assessed. Thirteen manifest entries are supported, but selected matching excerpts do not cover the whole synthesis or prove all table relationships. Sector metrics are explicitly outside independent checks. Displayed final doc_id list uses ellipses, despite full handles available in job.6 and machine manifests.
findings.acceptance_target: Render full resolvable claim-specific references automatically and distinguish quote support, independent fact verification and synthesis coverage.

limits: No determination that the corpus globally lacks November A-share reports.
No claim that the source numeric values themselves are false.
This run differs from 49e in question and tools; latency/token comparisons are descriptive, not controlled experiments.
No calculation-target obligation was generated; this run does not establish the arithmetic gate is fixed.
